goal: Defend the VLM financial document extraction TP in 21 slides, teaching every part and interpreting measured evidence honestly.

deck_context.source_summary: One Moroccan balance sheet, 2 pages, closing year 2024; 90 printed lines normalized to 88 canonical items. Minimum JSON has poste, rubrique, montant_net_N and montant_net_N1. Enriched Python pipeline uses catalogue without amounts, Gemini REST and Ollama Qwen3-VL 4B Instruct CPU, strict JSON/schema/business validation, Decimal arithmetic and evaluation against a work reference.
deck_context.verified_results: Main delivery principal_relecture: 107/107 amounts, 74/74 nets, 88/88 items, 66 coherent checks, 31.694s. Initial main failed a connection, retained. Benchmark six cumulative methods, three repeats each, no validation retry. Baseline 0 accepted each; role/constraints/fewshot/schema 107 each repeat; json_mode 65/107 then107 then107 due a missing page on network incident. Local 864.543s, raw34/107, strict0,210 invalidNA,year3112. Degraded image API107/107,65.88s. Batch2files=1realcompany. NEW CPU extension measured separately: OCR only 107/107 in8.3967s; OCR+Qwen targeted review 3 real runs18.0944,16.0398,15.8055s median16.0398s, each107/107 amounts,74/74nets,352/352cell states/values,88rows,66checks. Qwen reviews4lowestOCRconfidence cells with image AND OCRproposals; allagree. Not pureVLM, OCR alone alreadycorrect, no independentannotation or causal precisionbenefit fromQwen. Old localfailure retained. Qwen alreadyloaded; times notmatchedcoldbenchmark.
deck_context.scope: No independent test corpus or double annotation. Do not claim universal100% reliability or MoE/GPU execution. The reference was used during development. No reference amounts enter model prompts. Web is a separate TypeScript adaptation with different image sizes/contract; its latency is not the Python measurement. Hybrid uses onlymaskedPNGpixels and catalogue labels, not PDFtext or reference amounts. Geometry columns fixedto suppliednormalbalance layout. OCRprior +Qwenrelecture are correlated.
deck_context.core_claim: Usable extraction combines a visual model, an explicit output contract and independent validation. Explain decisions and preserve negative results.
